nodes.description: Public string suffix appended to token URI metadata ('.json').
Mint price per token, 0.01 ether.
Hard cap of 1888 Larva Pacas tokens.
Maximum tokens mintable per transaction (20).
Boolean pause flag checked at the start of mint().
IPFS base URI used to build token metadata URIs.
Deploys LarvaPacas, sets ERC721 name/symbol and RandomlyAssigned supply/startFrom.
Internal override returning the baseURI state variable.
Payable mint entry point: validates pause, amount, supply cap and payment, then loops minting random token ids.
View helper returning all token ids owned by an address.
View returning concatenated baseURI + tokenId + baseExtension for an existing token.
onlyOwner function sending the full contract balance to msg.sender via send().
Overridden random token id generator using keccak of block/msg variables modulo remaining supply.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, owner check in withdraw and randomness seed.
Miner-influenceable block timestamp used as entropy in nextToken randomness.
External callback to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received during safe minting, executed before loop completion.
Low-level send of entire contract balance to msg.sender, revert-on-failure pattern with hardcoded gas.
Weak randomness computation from msg.sender, coinbase, difficulty, gaslimit and timestamp, plus unchecked index arithmetic.
User-supplied number of tokens to mint in mint().
Owner address passed to walletOfOwner().
Token id passed to tokenURI().
Token id returned by nextToken() inside the mint loop and passed to _safeMint.
Loop counter over the requested mint amount in mint().
Balance of _owner used to size the returned token id array.
Memory array of token ids built in walletOfOwner().
Cached base URI string read via _baseURI() inside tokenURI().

edges.reason: msg.sender (via _msgSender()) is used as the recipient of newly minted tokens in mint().
withdraw() is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender(), and sends funds to msg.sender.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random index in nextToken(), making the randomness caller-influenceable.
block.timestamp is used as an entropy source in nextToken randomness, giving miners influence over token assignment.
mint() calls nextToken() inside its loop to obtain a random token id.
nextToken() executes the weak randomness and index arithmetic operations.
mint() invokes _safeMint, which performs an external callback to the receiver contract.
IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received executes external code that can re-enter mint() before supply/loop state is fully updated.
withdraw() performs a low-level send of the whole balance to msg.sender before returning.
cost is multiplied by _mintAmount to verify the payable value in mint().
maxPACAS caps totalSupply() + _mintAmount in mint().
maxMintAmount bounds the user-supplied _mintAmount in mint().
paused state variable guards the mint() entry point.
_baseURI() returns the baseURI state variable.
baseURI contributes to the metadata string assembled in tokenURI().
baseExtension is appended to the generated token URI.
_mintAmount parameter drives the loop bound and payment checks in mint().
_owner parameter is used for balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex lookups in walletOfOwner().
tokenId parameter is validated and converted to string in tokenURI().
mint() assigns the nextToken() result to the mintIndex local variable.
mintIndex is passed into _safeMint as the new token id.
mint() loop counter i controls iteration over the requested mint amount.
walletOfOwner() stores balanceOf(_owner) in ownerTokenCount.
walletOfOwner() allocates and fills the tokenIds memory array.
tokenURI() caches the _baseURI() result in currentBaseURI.

normalization_plan.reason: Input parameter only exists as the argument of mint() and should be folded into that core function node.
_owner is only meaningful as the argument of walletOfOwner() and is absorbed into it.
tokenId is only used inside tokenURI() and is normalized into that function node.
mintIndex is a temporary within mint() and is merged into the enclosing core function.
Loop counter i belongs solely to mint()'s iteration and is merged into it.
ownerTokenCount is a temporary derived from balanceOf inside walletOfOwner() and folds into it.
tokenIds is the transient return buffer of walletOfOwner() and is merged into it.
currentBaseURI is a transient copy of the base URI inside tokenURI() and is folded into it.
